tools.name: send_query_to_workday_plugin
tools.description: Send a message to a Workday agent: a question or lookup (balances, status, policy) or a change (submit, approve, update). This tool can change Workday data. Confirm the details of a change with the user before sending it; the agent may also ask the user to confirm before it submits. Waits up to 20 seconds and joins the run; a terminal result includes text and ui_intent. If status is still pending or running, poll run status after 5 seconds. Pass agent_id for the target agent. Pass combination_id or thread_id to continue; when the prior run is interrupted with no ui_intent, the message resumes it.

message.description: The question or change request to send to the agent (e.g. "How much PTO do I have?" or "Request 3 days of PTO next week").

agent_id.description: agent_id must be a registered gateway agent id from the tool schema enum. Domain map: ess_agent_service (ESS). Never invent nicknames like "workday" or "hr", and never use an MCP server or tool name.

thread_id.description: Thread ID (UUID) from a prior response. Omit to start a new conversation.

combination_id.description: Continuation ID from a prior response. Its thread component (before the first colon) supersedes thread_id; remaining content is ignored.

tools.name: send_a2ui_action_to_workday_plugin
tools.description: Submit a structured Workday UI action. Waits up to 20 seconds and joins the run; a terminal result includes text and ui_intent. If status is still pending or running, poll run status after 5 seconds. Pass agent_id for the target agent. Pass combination_id or thread_id to continue.

context.description: Resolved context from the action definition.

agent_id.description: agent_id must be a registered gateway agent id from the tool schema enum. Domain map: ess_agent_service (ESS). Never invent nicknames like "workday" or "hr", and never use an MCP server or tool name.

thread_id.description: Thread ID (UUID) from a prior response. Preferred when resuming a pending UI interrupt on an existing conversation.

combination_id.description: Continuation ID from a prior response. Its thread component (before the first colon) supersedes thread_id; remaining content is ignored.

tools.name: get_workday_plugin_run_status
tools.description: Wait up to 20 seconds for an existing Workday agent run identified by agent_id, thread_id, and run_id, using the join API. Returns status, and includes text and ui_intent when the run finishes. If status is still pending or running, wait 5 seconds and call again with the same ids. After 2 minutes, continue that poll in a background task.
